name: Sociopath
source:
You and seven strangers are trapped inside a remote countryside mansion and forced into a deadly game.

Everyone is trying to survive and uncover the truth behind the situation.

But you are secretly assigned a different role: the killer.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4119540/]Steam[/url]]
